quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 41.78 billion, up 182.49% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 13.65 billion, up 241.70%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 13.09 billion, up 229.32%; operating cash flow RMB 1.80 billion, down 44.08%, mainly on higher cash paid for purchases. The company attributes revenue growth to higher sales of 1.6T and 800G high-end modules driven by compute-infrastructure construction and related capex, with 800G and 1.6T shipments and their share rising on large AI customers' strong investment.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 41.78 billion (+182.49%); net profit RMB 13.65 billion (+241.70%)

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and supply (half-year report): optical transceiver capacity 2,215 ten-thousand units in H1 2026 (1,161 ten-thousand a year earlier); output 1,886 ten-thousand units (940 ten-thousand); sales volume 1,899 ten-thousand units (905 ten-thousand). Production bases in Suzhou, Tongling, Chengdu, Taiwan and Thailand, with capacity being expanded to meet fast-growing demand. To secure key materials the company signs multi-year framework agreements with industry partners, keeps adding suppliers for optoelectronic chips and PCBs and locks supply-chain capacity in advance; offering both silicon-photonics and EML solutions diversifies its sourcing.
quarterly_data.figure: capacity 2,215 ten-thousand units (1,161 a year earlier); sales 1,899 ten-thousand units

quarterly_data.signal: Segments and regions (half-year report): optical transceiver revenue RMB 41.36 billion, up 186.56%, gross margin 46.59% (+6.63 points; 39.96% a year earlier). Overseas revenue about RMB 39,614.7 million, up 209.9% from RMB 12,781.4 million, on overseas cloud providers' compute investment, a high share at key customers and a wider customer base; overseas module sales 1,685 ten-thousand units. The company says it delivers high-speed modules in volume to most leading cloud providers and AI computing solution providers and remains a main supplier at several key customers. Domestic revenue grew steadily with rising 400G / 800G deliveries to leading domestic cloud providers, supported by Chengdu Zhihe's volume production. Other business revenue RMB 422.7 million (+18.3%) on automotive optoelectronics customers. TeraHop Pte. (Singapore) assets RMB 629,734.22 ten-thousand, 14.29% of net assets.
quarterly_data.figure: optical transceivers RMB 41.36 billion, gross margin 46.59%; overseas about RMB 39,614.7 million (+209.9%)

quarterly_data.signal: Products and technology (half-year report): 1.6T silicon-photonics modules entered volume ramp with shipments rising quarter by quarter and are the core product driving revenue growth; the company says it was first in the industry to ship 1.6T DR8 OSFP224. XPO and NPO products are in custom development or refinement. At OFC 2026 the company demonstrated a 12.8T 8xDR8 XPO module, a 6.4T 4xDR8 NPO module, a 1.6T OSFP 2xLR4 module based on TFLN MZM and an 800G LR2 coherent-lite module (demonstrations). It can mass-produce its own coherent devices, lasers and COSA, and co-founded the XPO MSA and Open CPX MSA.
quarterly_data.figure: 1.6T silicon-photonics modules in volume ramp; 12.8T XPO and 6.4T NPO demonstrated at OFC 2026

quarterly_data.signal: R&D (half-year report): R&D investment RMB 1,234,050,709.33 in H1 2026, up 110.62%, 2.95% of revenue; R&D expense about RMB 1,153.0 million, up 96.9% from RMB 585.6 million. Patents 530 at period-end, of which 253 invention patents; 47 granted in H1 2026 (20 invention).

Construction and balance sheet (half-year report): construction in progress RMB 3,707,416,577.70 at June 30, 2026 versus RMB 1,421,937,387.37 at the start of the year, mainly machinery awaiting installation (RMB 2,446,936,833.79) and fit-out works (RMB 1,256,024,362.02); no individual major CIP project is listed. Investment in H1 RMB 9,066,591,024.37 (+3,469.34%); investing cash outflow rose on purchases of long-term assets and outside investments. Fixed assets RMB 9.82 billion; inventory RMB 19.83 billion, including raw materials RMB 9.07 billion (RMB 4.60 billion at the start of the year); prepayments RMB 953,622,834.48 (RMB 134,110,191.04 at the start of the year).
quarterly_data.figure: CIP RMB 3,707,416,577.70 (from RMB 1,421,937,387.37); raw materials RMB 9.07 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Receivables concentration (half-year report; a share of receivables, not of sales - the half-year report gives no top-five customer table): the five largest debtors (not named) held RMB 10,911,298,954.24, 72.49% of receivables and contract assets at June 30, 2026, the largest 20.86%; accounts receivable RMB 15.00 billion (21.76% of total assets) versus RMB 6.28 billion at the start of the year.
quarterly_data.figure: top five debtors 72.49% of receivables; largest 20.86%

quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook (half-year report): it will raise R&D on 1.6T, 3.2T and faster modules and develop NPO, XPO, CPO and OCS next-generation optical interconnect for AI data centers; keep expanding global manufacturing and capacity reserves with diversified raw-material sourcing; extend its offering into thermal management, liquid cooling and data-center power; and pursue selective acquisitions and supply-chain investments.
